operators.name: log_softmax_dim1
semantics: Computes log_softmax over dim=1 for a 3D tensor: output[b,i,c] = x[b,i,c] - log(sum_{j=0}^{N-1} exp(x[b,j,c])) where N is size of dim=1.
Uses numerically stable algorithm: subtract max over dim=1 before exp and log.
Preserves input shape, dtype, device; supports non-contiguous strides by using data_ptr and indexing with strides.
Returns a new tensor with same shape as input.

operators.name: elu
semantics: Applies elementwise ELU with alpha=1.0: output = x if x > 0 else exp(x) - 1.
Preserves input shape, dtype, device; handles all values including non-positive.
Returns a new tensor with same shape as input.
Computes log softmax over dimension 1 of the input tensor with shape [128, 1024, 1024].
Consistent with torch.nn.functional.log_softmax: numerically stable, dtype float32.
Applies elementwise ELU activation with default alpha=1.0 to the result of step_001.
For each element: output = x if x > 0 else exp(x) - 1.
Returns the tensor obtained after ELU activation, shape [128, 1024, 1024], dtype float32, device cuda.
